verdict.rationale: RealtimeKit documents managed recording that can capture composite video, so multi-participant output in a single file is supported. The evidence never describes layout options for that composite recording. The 'default layout or customize' item refers to the prebuilt meeting UI, not recording output, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented recording layout options (grid/speaker/custom), details on composition configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, multi-participant recordings can be composed into a single output with documented layout options

citations.quote: Capture composite video or separate participant audio tracks.
Add managed recording or transcription if your app needs it.
